sources.title: Integration: Togo exempts all African nationals from visas
sources.publisher: Official Portal of the Togolese Republic
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Official Portal of the Togolese Republic publishes this 19 May 2026 Government decision and identifies its effective date.
sources.supportingExcerpt: À compter du 18 mai 2026, les ressortissants des États africains munis d’un passeport national valide n’auront plus besoin de visa.

sources.title: Voyage Togo official travel procedures portal
sources.officialityEvidence: The live government .gouv.tg travel portal presents official immigration formalities, visa application, its visa assistant, and the current all-African entry notice.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Tous les ressortissants africains munis d'un passeport valide peuvent entrer au Togo sans visa pour un séjour allant jusqu'à 30 jours.

sources.title: Application for a visa
sources.officialityEvidence: The national Service Public portal publishes the Government’s visa-service description and expressly preserves international, bilateral, exemption and reciprocity arrangements.
sources.supportingExcerpt: L'entrée au Togo de tout étranger est soumise à l'obtention préalable d'un visa.

sources.title: Togo Voyage live ordinary-passport visa assistant
sources.officialityEvidence: The current government .gouv.tg assistant collects an ordinary-passport issuer, travel purpose and stay details and posts to the same-origin official visa-check endpoint.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Vous n’avez pas besoin de visa.

policies.title: African ordinary passports: Togo visa-free short visit
policies.summary: From 18 May 2026, Togo’s Government exempts nationals of every African State holding a valid national passport. The live official portal confirms this ordinary-passport visitor route for stays up to 30 days.
conditions: Applies only to the named African passport issuers and a valid ordinary national passport, for a stay of up to 30 days.
The official portal requires completion of the immigration slip no later than 24 hours before arrival. This is an immigration formality, not an ETA or a visa.

The same live eVisa-information page retains an earlier ECOWAS-centred exemption table and lists some now-exempt African states as visa-subject. The 18 May 2026 Government decision, homepage notice and live ordinary-passport checker control; the legacy table is recorded as a source conflict, not used to narrow the African exemption.
Border inspection, security, legal controls and individual admissibility remain; residence, work, transit, crew, diplomatic, official/service and special-document rules are outside this policy.

policies.title: Togo-issued ordinary passport: no foreign-entry visa in the live assistant
policies.summary: The live ordinary-passport assistant returns no visa for a Togolese passport. This directly supports only the repository's citizenship classification; it does not assert constitutional return rights or treatment of other documents.
conditions: The assistant was queried as an ordinary Togolese passport with short visitor assumptions and returns no visa. Separate identity, nationality, border, security and admission rules remain applicable.
This does not infer treatment for national identity cards, consular cards, residence documents or diplomatic, official, service, refugee, emergency or other special travel documents.

policies.title: Singapore and Malaysia ordinary passports: live assistant no-visa result
policies.summary: The live official ordinary-passport assistant returns no visa for Singapore and Malaysia under the short tourist test inputs. The 2026 African rule does not explain these two non-African outcomes, so they are separate and medium confidence.
conditions: The current checker returns no visa for ordinary Singapore and Malaysian passports with a short tourist stay. It does not publish an underlying bilateral instrument, duration or document/purpose crosswalk.
Separate immigration formalities, border inspection, security, admissibility, work, residence, transit, crew, diplomatic, official, service and special-document rules remain outside this policy.

policies.title: Live checker non-African ordinary-passport tourist cohort: advance electronic visa
policies.summary: For this complete named cohort, the live ordinary-passport assistant returns that a visa is required. Togo Voyage identifies the product as an electronic visa, requires online application before travel, and says it avoids a border-visa queue; it is normalized as evisa.
conditions: The current assistant was queried for each listed ordinary passport with a short tourist stay and returned that a visa is required. The eVisa page's country table independently lists each as visa-subject, subject to stated bilateral or multilateral arrangements.

The current portal says applications must be made online at least five days before arrival; standard processing is five days. Its tourist table provides 1–15 day single or multiple entry, 16–30 day multiple entry, and 31–90 day multiple entry options.

Arrival and express visas are currently suspended. The portal labels the advance product eVisa, says it avoids a border-visa queue and sends confirmation by email; normal border, passport, funds, health, security and admission requirements remain.

The legacy table contains stale African visa-required rows, overridden by the separate current African policy. Work, residence, official/courtesy, diplomatic, service, transit, crew and special-document routes are excluded.

application.label: Togo Voyage electronic tourist-visa application
application.processingTime: The current portal says standard visa applications take five days and must be made at least five days before arrival.
steps: Use the official visa assistant with an ordinary passport, visitor purpose, intended arrival date and stay duration.
If the assistant says a visa is required, create an account and complete the online application, supporting documents and online payment.
Carry the approved electronic-visa confirmation and complete the separate immigration formalities before travel.
